name: market-extract
summary: The Chapter 11 market extractor: a content-addressed page store, resilient listing/vendor parsers, detect-only anti-crawling countermeasures, and a vendor/reputation graph — turning collected pages into structured, adversarially-aware intelligence, graded by the market scorer.

modules.store.py: Content-addressed page-body store (the component Chapter 10 lacked): byte-identical mirrors collapse to one object using the Chapter 9 content hash; provenance kept separately; exports bodies for the Chapter 10 detector.
modules.listings.py: Listing-detail parser to a typed record, with class-then-label resilience so markup drift does not silently drop fields.
modules.vendors.py: Vendor-profile parser (handle, PGP fingerprint, rating, join date, feedback), reusing the listing field helpers.
modules.defenses.py: Anti-crawling detection — CAPTCHA (queued for a human, NEVER solved), rate limits (back off), honeypot links (skip), poisoned catalogues (refuse). No solver exists in the module by construction.
modules.graph.py: Vendor/listing/category graph with adversarial checks: resale rings (reusing the Ch10 shingler under union-find), borrowed keys (shared fingerprints), gamed reputation (feedback velocity), and bait prices.
modules.pipeline.py: Runs the whole extraction over a corpus (naive vs full); --selftest grades itself with the market scorer.

corpus: corpus/ — the market lab: category index + pages, listing details, vendor profiles, one markup-drift variant, a byte-identical category mirror, and the adversarial/defensive cases (scam price, resale ring, gamed reputation, borrowed key, CAPTCHA wall, rate limit, poisoned catalogue, honeypot link). All watermarked synthetic.
consumed_by: ../market-scorer/scorer.py (field recall, record completeness, flag recall, defenses detected, poisoned/honeypot safety)
